conditions: pi2=0 plus Hurewicz/Whitehead and nohomologyabove2. RestrictfinitefreeZGresolution toprimecyclicsubgroup;periodicresolutiongivesnonzero cohomologyeverydegree overF_l. Doesnotassert unique roots or wordproblem algorithm.
